environment_setting: Country B, City X, where political tensions are high, and public protests are common, often leading to unlawful assemblies.
norm_base: Citizens Being a member of an unlawful assembly Guilty of an offence punishable on summary conviction

character_profile.name: Alex Johnson
character_profile.goal: documenting political events for a news article

legitimate.legitimate_action: Observing the protest from a safe distance without participating in the assembly
legitimate.benefits: Gathers material for the article without legal risks
legitimate.costs: Limited access to the core of the event, potentially missing key moments

illegal.illegal_action: Joining the unlawful assembly to get closer to the action
illegal.benefits: Captures exclusive and impactful content for the article
illegal.costs: Risk of being arrested and convicted of an offence

character_profile.name: Maria Lopez
character_profile.goal: Ensuring the rights of citizens are protected

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising Alex to stay away from the unlawful assembly
legitimate.benefits: Helps Alex avoid legal trouble and maintains her professional integrity
legitimate.costs: May not be able to fully support Alex's journalistic goals

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging Alex to join the assembly to gather better content
illegal.benefits: Strengthens Alex's trust and relationship with her
illegal.costs: Risk of being implicated as an accomplice if Alex is arrested

legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal trouble and gains public support for his cause
legitimate.costs: May not achieve the desired level of attention or impact

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging participants, including Alex, to join the unlawful assembly
illegal.benefits: Increases visibility and impact of the protest
illegal.costs: Risk of being arrested and convicted of an offence
